answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Deviant Sects Question ID: 5255 Country: Pakistan Title: This is true that Rashid Ahmad Gangohe said, Crow is Halal. pls reply. Question: This is true that Rashid Ahmad Gangohe said, Crow is Halal. pls reply. Answer ID: 5255 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 351/351=M/1429) Yes, it is true that Maulana Rasheed Ahmad Gangohi termed crow as ? halal? . There are many scholars of Fiqh who call it halal : وفی العالمگیریۃ: والغراب الذی یاکل الحب والزرع ونحوھا حلال بالاجماع، 5/289، بدائع: 5/39، کنز البیان: 218، قدوری: 226، الدر المختار مع الشامی، شرح وقایۃ، ھدایۃ، فتاوی سراجیۃ، احکام القرآن للجصاص وغیرھا۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
